tasks.label: Kill Ports - RagGateway
tasks.command: $ports=@(5200,7200); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($c in $conns){ Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host 'Kill Ports - RagGateway done'
